deploy-bot: [DEPLOYMENT] rollback initiated — env=prod-us-west-2 service=runtime from_tag=release/v2.7.3 to_tag=release/v2.7.2 commit=4f3a1c8 reason=error-rate+latency-spike threshold=5% triggered_by=canary-monitor incident=INC-4521 initiated_by=oliver

oliver: rolling back now. Canary started seeing sustained p95 latency > 1.2s and kv-cache miss amplification. manual rollback to previous pinned release. tagging done. pinging SRE for routing + post-checks.

raj: on it. I'll divert traffic to standby pool and scale down the canary nodes. running quick health checks.

oliver: command run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime -n prod --to-revision=release-v2.7.2`

raj: rollout undo accepted. starting gradual reroute: `trafficctl route set runtime --env prod-us-west-2 --to pool=stable --percent=100 --dry-run=false`

jen: QA will run smoke suite against runtime once rollback completes. I'm queued to run `smoke/runtime/basic` and `smoke/runtime/kv` in about 3m.

deploy-bot: [UPDATE] rollback progress=50% tasks=[undo-apply,route-switch,healthchecks] started_at=1955002468

raj: health checks passing on 80% of nodes. error rate trending down. kv-hit rate recovering.

maria: opened follow-up: https://phab/INC-4521 - added notes about canary thresholds + suggested guardrail change. I'll own postmortem and change window analysis.

oliver: pinning release/v2.7.2 as active. will not auto-promote v2.7.3 until regression is understood.

deploy-bot: [COMPLETE] rollback completed — env=prod-us-west-2 service=runtime to_tag=release/v2.7.2 commit=9b2d4a1 status=success duration=5m2s pinned=true notes=traffic_rerouted;smoke_ok

jen: smoke suite passed. all clear from QA :white_check_mark:

raj: monitoring for 30m window. setting alert threshold lower for now and flagging for oncall.

oliver: thanks team. next steps: (1) collect traces and perf diffs, (2) reproduce in staging with exact workload, (3) hold v2.7.3 until fix. I'll spin up a small investigation channel.

sre-bot: New incident INC-4521 assigned to raj. SLA timer started.

maria: thanks, moving the release notes entry for v2.7.3 -> holding and adding rollback summary.

oliver: closing thread here, will link incident and postmortem once ready. :thumbsup:
